title: Set up, Java toolkit, fast input
focus: Accounts, the Java collections you will use every day, and how FastScanner replaces Scanner.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.hint: One pass: before storing a[i], look for target − a[i] in the map.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.hint: Count letters in an int[26]; one string adds, the other subtracts.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.hint: ArrayDeque as a stack: push the closer you expect, pop and compare.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.hint: HashMap of counts, then a min-heap of size k (or buckets by count).

problems.title: My Calendar I
problems.hint: TreeMap start → end. Check floorKey(start) and ceilingKey(start) for overlap.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.hint: Three pointers: prev, cur, next.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.hint: Slow moves 1, fast moves 2; they meet only if there is a cycle.

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.hint: Key = the sorted letters of the word.

title: Prefix sums, difference arrays, hashing
focus: Count subarrays by remembering earlier prefix values in a HashMap.

problems.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
problems.hint: Prefix + HashMap seeded with {0: 1}.

problems.title: Subarray Sums Divisible by K
problems.hint: Key = Math.floorMod(prefix, k); equal remainders make a valid subarray.

problems.title: Number of Sub-arrays With Odd Sum
problems.hint: Count odd and even prefixes seen so far.

problems.title: Contiguous Array
problems.hint: Treat 0 as −1; store the FIRST index of each prefix value.

problems.title: Corporate Flight Bookings
problems.hint: Difference array.

title: Two pointers and sliding window
focus: Grow the window on the right; shrink it on the left while it is invalid.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.hint: Window with a count (or last-seen index) per character.

problems.title: Max Consecutive Ones III
problems.hint: Window with at most K zeros: the vacation pattern.

problems.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
problems.hint: Valid while window length − (most frequent count) ≤ k.

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.hint: Sort, fix i, two pointers on the rest, skip duplicates.

problems.title: Subarrays with K Different Integers
problems.hint: Exactly K = atMost(K) − atMost(K − 1).

problems.title: Sliding Window Maximum
problems.hint: Monotonic deque of indices.

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring
problems.hint: Counts of what you need vs what the window has; shrink while valid.

title: Sorting and greedy: intervals
focus: Sort by the right key, then make one decision per element. Check the greedy by swapping two choices.

problems.title: Merge Intervals
problems.hint: Sort by start; extend the last interval while they overlap.

problems.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
problems.hint: Sort by end; answer = n − (most you can keep).

problems.title: Divide Intervals Into Minimum Number of Groups
problems.hint: This is "minimum platforms": sweep sorted starts and ends.

problems.title: Largest Number
problems.hint: Sort strings with (b + a).compareTo(a + b). All zeros → "0".

problems.title: Maximum Number of Consecutive Values You Can Make
problems.hint: Sort; if a coin > reach + 1, stop, else reach += coin.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
problems.hint: Sort by end; touching balloons share an arrow.

problems.title: Candy
problems.hint: Two passes: left to right, then right to left.

title: Greedy with heaps
focus: Unlock options in sorted order, keep the unlocked ones in a heap, undo your worst choice when a limit breaks.

problems.title: IPO
problems.hint: Sort projects by capital; heap of profits you can afford.

problems.title: Furthest Building You Can Reach
problems.hint: Min-heap of the climbs given ladders; the smallest pays bricks.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Increments on Subarrays to Form a Target Array
problems.hint: Answer = sum of the positive rises a[i] − a[i−1].

problems.title: Last Stone Weight
problems.hint: Max-heap: poll two, push the difference.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Refueling Stops
problems.hint: Heap of fuel at stations you have passed; refuel from the biggest when stuck.

problems.title: Course Schedule III
problems.hint: Sort by deadline; max-heap of durations; drop the longest when over time.

title: Binary search, including on the answer
focus: When "can the answer be x?" is monotone, binary search x and check it greedily.

problems.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
problems.hint: Lower bound of x, and lower bound of x + 1, minus 1.

problems.title: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.hint: Smallest speed with total hours ≤ h. Hours for a pile = ceil(pile / speed).

problems.title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
problems.hint: Smallest capacity whose greedy day count ≤ days.

problems.title: Split Array Largest Sum
problems.hint: Same check as ship capacity: count parts greedily.

problems.title: Magnetic Force Between Two Balls
problems.hint: Largest gap that still places m balls (round mid up).

problems.title: Maximum Candies Allocated to K Children
problems.hint: Largest amount x with Σ pile / x ≥ k.

problems.title: Find K-th Smallest Pair Distance
problems.hint: Binary search the distance; count pairs ≤ d with two pointers.

title: Monotonic stacks
focus: Next or previous greater/smaller element for every index in O(n), and the contribution trick.

problems.title: Daily Temperatures
problems.hint: Next greater element to the right; answer = index difference.

problems.title: Next Greater Element II
problems.hint: Circular: loop i from 0 to 2n − 1 and use i % n.

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.hint: Previous and next smaller bar give the width for each bar.

problems.title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
problems.hint: Contribution counting, then mod 10⁹+7.

problems.title: Remove K Digits
problems.hint: Greedy stack: pop while the top is bigger than the current digit.

problems.title: Remove Duplicate Letters
problems.hint: Stack + last index of each letter + "already in stack" flags.

problems.title: Sum of Subarray Ranges
problems.hint: Sum of maximums minus sum of minimums, both by contribution.

title: Bits and XOR
focus: Each bit is independent in a sum of XORs. A trie answers pair questions; a basis answers subset questions.

problems.title: Single Number
problems.hint: XOR everything; pairs cancel.

problems.title: Count Triplets That Can Form Two Arrays of Equal XOR
problems.hint: a == b means xor(i..k) == 0: equal prefix XORs.

problems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array
problems.hint: Binary trie; for each x, walk towards the opposite bits.

problems.title: Count Pairs With XOR in a Range
problems.hint: Trie with counts: pairs with XOR < high + 1 minus pairs with XOR < low.

problems.title: Minimize XOR
problems.hint: Greedy on bits: match num1's high bits first, then fill low bits.

problems.title: Maximum XOR With an Element From Array
problems.hint: Offline: sort queries by limit, insert numbers into the trie as they qualify.

title: Number theory toolkit
focus: gcd, sieves, fast power, inverses, nCr, and the square-free kernel.

problems.title: Count Primes
problems.hint: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to n − 1.

problems.title: Count Good Numbers
problems.hint: 5^(even positions) × 4^(odd positions) with fast power mod 10⁹+7.

problems.title: Number of Subarrays With GCD Equal to K
problems.hint: For each start, extend while gcd is a multiple of k; stop early otherwise.

problems.title: Maximum Element-Sum of a Complete Subset of Indices
problems.hint: Group indices by square-free kernel; the best group sum wins.

problems.title: Number of Different Subsequences GCDs
problems.hint: For each g, gcd of all multiples of g present in the array; count when it equals g.

problems.title: Count the Number of Square-Free Subsets
problems.hint: Numbers ≤ 30: bitmask of the 10 primes, knapsack over masks.

title: DP I: states, transitions, knapsack
focus: Define the state in words before writing any code.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.hint: Take or skip: best[i] = max(best[i−1], best[i−2] + a[i−1]).

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.hint: dp[a] = min over coins of dp[a − c] + 1; start with a large INF.

problems.title: Coin Change II
problems.hint: Combinations: coins in the outer loop, amount in the inner loop.

problems.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
problems.hint: Boolean subset sum to total / 2, looping the sum downwards.

problems.title: Target Sum
problems.hint: Count subsets with sum (total + target) / 2.

problems.title: Last Stone Weight II
problems.hint: Split into two groups as equal as possible: subset sum up to total / 2.

problems.title: Delete and Earn
problems.hint: Sum points per value, then House Robber over values.

title: DP II: two-string DP
focus: dp[i][j] over the prefixes of two strings.

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.hint: Match → diagonal + 1, else the better of up and left.

problems.title: Edit Distance
problems.hint: Insert, delete, replace = left, up, diagonal + 1.

problems.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
problems.hint: dp[l][r] on one string, or LCS with its reverse.

problems.title: Minimum Insertion Steps to Make a String Palindrome
problems.hint: n − longest palindromic subsequence.

problems.title: Distinct Subsequences
problems.hint: dp[i][j] = dp[i−1][j] + (match ? dp[i−1][j−1] : 0). Use long.

problems.title: Interleaving String
problems.hint: dp[i][j] = can the first i of s1 and j of s2 form the first i + j of s3.

problems.title: Shortest Common Supersequence
problems.hint: Build the LCS table, then walk back to print.

title: DP III: LIS and DP with an extra dimension
focus: LIS in O(n log n), DP over values with a Fenwick tree, and an extra state for a side condition.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.hint: Write the O(n log n) tails version.

problems.title: Find the Longest Valid Obstacle Course at Each Position
problems.hint: Non-decreasing LIS: upper bound; the answer at i is the position + 1.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Removals to Make Mountain Array
problems.hint: LIS ending at i from the left and from the right; peak needs both ≥ 2.

problems.title: Longest Ideal Subsequence
problems.hint: dp over the last letter: 26 states.

problems.title: Russian Doll Envelopes
problems.hint: Sort by width ascending, height descending; LIS on heights.

problems.title: Number of Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.hint: For each i, keep (length, count).

title: DP IV: divisor, interval and game DP
focus: Loops over multiples, dp[l][r] by length, and "my score minus yours" for two-player games.

problems.title: Largest Divisible Subset
problems.hint: Sort; LIS-style DP where j → i is allowed if a[i] % a[j] == 0.

problems.title: Predict the Winner
problems.hint: dp[l][r] = max(a[l] − dp[l+1][r], a[r] − dp[l][r−1]).

problems.title: Minimum Cost to Cut a Stick
problems.hint: Add 0 and n as cuts; interval DP over cut indices.

problems.title: Stone Game VII
problems.hint: Same game DP; the score of a move is the sum of what is left (prefix sums).

problems.title: Count the Number of Ideal Arrays
problems.hint: Divisor chains of s distinct values × C(n − 1, s − 1).

problems.title: Burst Balloons
problems.hint: Choose the LAST balloon to burst in (l, r).

problems.title: Strange Printer
problems.hint: dp[l][r]; when s[k] == s[l], the two prints can merge.

title: Graphs I: BFS, DFS, topological order
focus: Shortest paths by edges, grids, multi-source BFS, Kahn's algorithm and DP on a DAG.

problems.title: Number of Islands
problems.hint: Each unvisited land cell starts a BFS/DFS that marks its island.

problems.title: Rotting Oranges
problems.hint: Multi-source BFS from every rotten orange; the answer is the last layer.

problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.hint: Kahn's algorithm; possible iff every course gets processed.

problems.title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
problems.hint: BFS with 8 directions; distance counts cells, so start at 1.

problems.title: Is Graph Bipartite?
problems.hint: BFS colouring; a neighbour with the same colour means no.

problems.title: Minimum Cost to Make at Least One Valid Path in a Grid
problems.hint: 0-1 BFS: following the arrow costs 0, changing it costs 1.

problems.title: Parallel Courses III
problems.hint: Topological order; finish[v] = time[v] + max finish of prerequisites.

title: Graphs II: Dijkstra, DSU, MST
focus: Weighted shortest paths, expanded state graphs, union-find and Kruskal.

problems.title: Network Delay Time
problems.hint: Dijkstra from k; the answer is the largest distance (−1 if any is unreachable).

problems.title: Path With Minimum Effort
problems.hint: Dijkstra where a path costs its largest step.

problems.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
problems.hint: MST over all pairs (Kruskal, or Prim in O(n²)).

problems.title: Number of Ways to Arrive at Destination
problems.hint: Dijkstra plus ways[]; distances need long.

problems.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
problems.hint: State = (city, stops), or Bellman-Ford for k + 1 rounds.

problems.title: Minimum Obstacle Removal to Reach Corner
problems.hint: 0-1 BFS: an obstacle cell costs 1.

problems.title: Number of Good Paths
problems.hint: Process nodes by value; DSU joins neighbours with value ≤ current.

title: Trees I: recursion, parent arrays, LCA
focus: LeetCode TreeNode recursion, general trees without recursion, and binary lifting.

problems.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.hint: Height of each side; the diameter bends at some node.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
problems.hint: Return the node if it is p or q; if both sides return something, this is the LCA.

problems.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
problems.hint: Return the best downward sum; drop negative branches.

problems.title: Longest Path With Different Adjacent Characters
problems.hint: Parent array input: reverse BFS order, keep the two best child chains.

problems.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problems.hint: BFS; process q.size() nodes per level.

problems.title: Kth Ancestor of a Tree Node
problems.hint: Binary lifting table.

problems.title: Minimum Fuel Cost to Report to the Capital
problems.hint: Subtree sizes: each edge needs ceil(size / seats) cars.

problems.title: Minimum Edge Weight Equilibrium Queries in a Tree
problems.hint: LCA plus counts of each weight (1..26) on the root path.

title: Trees II: tree DP, rerooting, small-to-large
focus: dp[v][state] from the children, answers for every root in O(n), and merging the smaller set into the larger.

problems.title: House Robber III
problems.hint: Each node returns {best if robbed, best if not}.

problems.title: Number of Nodes in the Sub-Tree With the Same Label
problems.hint: Count labels per subtree: int[26] per node, merged from children (edges given: root it first).

problems.title: Sum of Distances in Tree
problems.hint: Rerooting: ans[child] = ans[parent] − size[child] + (n − size[child]).

problems.title: Find the Maximum Sum of Node Values
problems.hint: Any even number of nodes can be XORed; greedy by gain, or dp[v][parity].

problems.title: Minimum Edge Reversals So Every Node Is Reachable
problems.hint: Rerooting over edge directions: reversals from 0, then adjust per edge.

problems.title: Smallest Missing Genetic Value in Each Subtree
problems.hint: Only the path from the node with value 1 to the root matters; or small-to-large sets.

title: Fenwick trees and segment trees
focus: Point updates with range queries for sum, min and gcd, coordinate compression, and Euler tours.

problems.title: Range Sum Query - Mutable
problems.hint: Fenwick or segment tree; update stores the difference.

problems.title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
problems.hint: Compress values; scan from the right, query the Fenwick tree, then add.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence II
problems.hint: Segment tree of max over values; query [x − k, x − 1].

problems.title: Booking Concert Tickets in Groups
problems.hint: Segment tree of max and sum; descend to the first row with room.

problems.title: Maximum Sum of Subsequence With Non-adjacent Elements
problems.hint: Each node stores 4 values: best with or without its two ends.

problems.title: Minimum Score After Removals on a Tree
problems.hint: Euler tour times decide whether one removed subtree contains the other.

title: Lazy segment trees and the K-parts DP
focus: Range updates, then the split-into-K-parts DP that Infosys reuses for its hardest problems.

problems.title: Minimum Difficulty of a Job Schedule
problems.hint: dp[day][i] over the last day's start; cost = max of that part.

problems.title: Largest Sum of Averages
problems.hint: dp[k][i] with prefix sums for the average of a part.

problems.title: Subarrays Distinct Element Sum of Squares II
problems.hint: Lazy segment tree over start positions: a new element adds 1 to a range of starts.

problems.title: My Calendar III
problems.hint: Lazy segment tree (range add, global max), or a TreeMap sweep.

title: Backtracking, bitmask DP, digit DP
focus: Brute force for partial marks, dp[mask] for n ≤ 20, and counting numbers digit by digit.

problems.title: Subsets
problems.hint: Bitmask loop, or choose / skip recursion.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Work Sessions to Finish the Tasks
problems.hint: dp[mask] = (sessions, time used in the last one), compared in that order.

problems.title: Minimum XOR Sum of Two Arrays
problems.hint: Assignment with dp[mask]: the next element of nums1 picks an unused element of nums2.

problems.title: Numbers At Most N Given Digit Set
problems.hint: Shorter lengths: |D|^len. Same length: digit by digit with tight.

problems.title: N-Queens
problems.hint: Backtracking with column and two diagonal flags.

problems.title: Shortest Path Visiting All Nodes
problems.hint: BFS over (node, visited mask).

problems.title: Number of Beautiful Integers in the Range
problems.hint: Digit DP: (pos, even − odd, remainder mod k, tight, started).

title: Consolidate
focus: Templates from memory, a speed drill, and error-log re-solves. No new topics.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.hint: Speed drill: HashSet.

problems.title: Boats to Save People
problems.hint: Speed drill: sort + two pointers.

problems.title: Successful Pairs of Spells and Potions
problems.hint: Speed drill: sort + lower bound.

title: Rest and logistics
focus: One warm-up, pack, plan the route, sleep.

problems.title: Running Sum of 1d Array
problems.hint: 5-minute warm-up.
